title: E0105: Local File Inclusion
plain_english: Including or reading a local file based on user-controlled input can allow an attacker to read arbitrary files on your server or execute code.
why_matters: Local file inclusion (LFI) can: - Read sensitive files (`/etc/passwd`, source code, credentials, config files) - Include uploaded files containing malicious PHP code - Lead to remote code execution when combined with file upload
what_it_checks: `include`, `require`, `include_once`, and `require_once` with paths built from tainted input
`../` or null byte (`%00`) sequences in user-controlled paths
